hypothesis: Rev6 established that trend-regime conditioning stabilizes SOL's feature-to-direction signs (bull 85% / bear 60% train-to-VAL sign agreement vs 0% unconditional) but its all-feature per-regime experts still lost (-29.5% VAL): with only ~19-21k train rows per trend regime and 126 features, the experts drown the few sign-stable relationships in regime-noise. Hypothesis: restricting each regime's expert to that regime's own top-K oracle-matched features (per-regime univariate direction AUC, selected on TRAIN only) raises signal-to-noise enough to clear costs -- the same filtering that WORSENED the unconditional model (rev 2026-08-08 feature analysis: -32..-54%) should HELP within regime, because within regime the selected signs are stable rather than inverted.

research.prior_failure_reassessment: The unconditional top-20-filtered LGBM was far worse than the full-feature control precisely because unconditional top-train features invert on VAL (0/20 sign agreement) -- filtering concentrated the inversion damage. Within-regime the same measurement shows 85%/60% sign agreement (bull/bear), so the identical filtering operation acts on stable relationships instead; rev6 Stage M never tested filtering. This is the one unexplored cell of the {conditioning} x {filtering} design matrix.
research.retest_design: Regime = rev6's frozen D2 detector (288-bar return +/-4%, training-free causal). Stage 1 (analysis, train-only): per-regime feature distributions (pairwise KS separation) and per-regime univariate direction AUC; per-regime top-K feature lists frozen from TRAIN only, K in {10, 20} pre-registered. Stage 2: per-regime LightGBM 3-class experts trained on that regime's top-K features only (purged train, same hyperparameters as every prior LGBM in this line); chop expert included but its regime showed 35% sign stability -- a pre-registered variant additionally forces CASH in chop (no chop expert), giving 2 K-values x 2 chop-policies x 6 entry-rule thresholds = 24 VAL configs. VAL selection requires PnL > 0, >= 15 trades, >= 3 of 4 VAL months positive, and > the unconditional LGBM control (-6.90%); ONE OOS read of the single selected config; adoption requires OOS PnL > 0. Failure closes the {regime x filtering} cell.

model.candidate_architecture: D2 trend-regime router + per-regime LightGBM experts restricted to per-regime train-selected top-K oracle-matched features (K in {10,20}), optional forced-CASH-in-chop

selection.validation_pass_criteria: best of the 24 pre-registered configs must have VAL PnL > 0, >=15 trades, >=3/4 VAL months positive, and beat the unconditional control (-6.90%); single OOS read; adoption requires OOS PnL > 0
